name: EPIC 206358304
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 9.6 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206358304 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.596388 (16th-84th percentiles 9.351127-9.913476), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206358304 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.835261 (16th-84th percentiles 0.789938-0.898252), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206358304: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4782.1353 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206358304 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3933.632812 (16th-84th percentiles 3855.585938-4021.40625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.14 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,934 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.84 solar masses and 9.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,782 K at its surface.
